name: stats
description: Model usage analytics for tokens, cost, cache efficiency and generation speed. Uses Elowen's shared usage ledger and keeps task tracking focused on work rather than infrastructure spend.

strings.title: Statistics
strings.workspaceIntro: Review token volume, tracked cost, cache use and generation speed across models.
strings.tokensByModelHint: Share of all recorded tokens in the selected range.
strings.costByModelHint: Share of tracked spend; models without cost data are excluded.
strings.trendHint: Daily tokens and tracked cost from the shared usage ledger, up to 90 days.
strings.trendUnavailable: The daily trend is available only for the latest 90 days.
strings.emptyDescription: Model consumption in the selected range will appear here.
strings.noChartData: No data is available for this chart.
strings.resetBody: This permanently clears recorded task usage snapshots and your recorded chat usage. Conversations and agent session transcripts remain available.
strings.resetFailed: Usage statistics could not be reset.
strings.originTrackedSince: Tracked since {day}. Consumption before that date has no recorded origin.
strings.originTrackedNever: No consumption with a recorded origin yet.
strings.originUntrustedWarning: {count} entries come from a header that cannot be verified.
strings.originUntrustedHelp: An address is verifiable only when the request passed through the configured reverse proxy. Everything else is a claim made by the client itself. Turn Trusted proxy off in the runtime settings if this instance is not behind such a proxy.
strings.originEmptyBody: Consumption with a recorded origin will appear here once turns are processed in the selected period.
strings.originFootnote: Tokens and cost are two different rankings. An IP address identifies a connection, not a person.
